newsitem.title: THAILAND: Wall Street Finance to issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street Finance to issue shares.

text.p: Wall Street Finance and Securities Plc said on Monday it will raise capital to 988.4 million baht ($38.02 million) by issuing 46.5 million shares.
A total of 20.4 million of the new shares will be offered to existing shareholders at a ratio of two old shares to one new share at 10 baht each.
Another 20 million shares will be allocated to eight individual investors through a private placement at a price of 15 baht each.
The remaining 6.1 million shares will be reserved for the exercise of convertible debentures and warrants, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
